lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is a joint work session Wednesday where the Planning Commission and Board of County Commissioners dig into proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, geothermal operations, and condominium plats — the kind of behind-the-scenes shaping that determines what gets built and how in San Miguel County. The same evening, commissioners make a rare trip to Norwood for a special meeting that includes appointing a Planning Commission alternate and hearing results of the Placerville Fire Survey. The week rounds out with the Ecology Commission reviewing the 2022 Climate Action Plan on transportation and consumption.

notable.stake: Land Use Code rewrites on forestry, oil, gas, geothermal, and condos being drafted now.
